scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing

layout./out/build: read-only retained kernel build tree, exact frozen binding pending
layout./out/source/linux-6.12.0-211.44.1.el10_2: read-only matching retained kernel source tree, exact frozen binding pending
layout./work/output/build: fresh exclusively owned writable configure output and safe ancestors, pre-entry requirement
layout.temporary_and_home: separate exclusively owned writable locations, exact paths and tool effects pending

rules: This is not an executable command or authorization. Bind exact actual generated argv and transitive inputs in a reviewed profile.
Forbid output-tree redirection via ambient KBUILD_OUTPUT or O; explicitly bind or unset Kbuild environment variables and make/tool paths.
Read-only /out must cover both build and source at the absolute paths expected by the retained output Makefile.
Do not run clean, modules_install, prepare_after_cross, internal kernel prepare, or other targets as part of this probe.
Observe direct make exit and verify the generated driver.ko and exact MAP_KERNEL_START using the previously reviewed source-bound verifier; separately check generated cache and emitted compile flags.
If read-only access fails, preserve the failure and stop; do not remount writable or retry automatically. A fresh owned snapshot requires separate independent review and admission.
side_effects_unproven: Subprocesses, compiler, objtool, pahole, resolve_btfids, shell and make may access or write paths not established by the selected source rules.
Generated dependency/command files and temporary files require observation in the admitted run; output containment and source quiescence are not established.
The configured BTF path may read the 345265952-byte vmlinux and execute tools; resource and workload classification remain unreviewed.
